_comment: Regression screen config, PER SCOPE. Copy to regression.json (gitignored, per server). SECRETS are NOT here: the git token (HTTPS only) stays in .env as REGRESSION_GIT_TOKEN_<SCOPE> (or REGRESSION_GIT_TOKEN). For an ssh:// git_url, set git_ssh_key (+ git_known_hosts) below instead of a token — the engine builds GIT_SSH_COMMAND from them. Use forward slashes in paths. refresh_databases lists THIS scope's refreshable DBs for THIS server's env, GROUPED by category (e.g. BATCH / REPORTING) shown as a grouped dropdown; DEV/STG can have several per group; per-server file, so the DEV server lists DEV DBs and the STG server lists STG DBs. script_roots maps each DB to its repo-relative Scripts folder; the tool appends the selected <release_date> (YYYYMMDD) folder and runs the chosen chg*.sql from it. test_roots maps each DB to its RegressionTesting folder (parallel to Scripts) — the Reset/Trigger steps list .sql from there. cib+retail can share ONE git_url (split by CIB/ vs RET/ folders); group is its own repo. Use '*' as the DB key when one Scripts root serves every DB in the scope. filecopy_verify sets the post-copy integrity check for the File-copy step: 'size' (default — destination byte size must match source, catches truncated/zero-byte copies), 'hash' (also compares SHA-256 — catches same-size corruption, slower as it re-reads both files), or 'off'. Any key left out falls back to defaults, then to the legacy REGRESSION_* .env var.
